remediation.suggestion: Keep the stated data-minimization rules, obtain explicit authorization before writes, and enforce retention and erasure controls in the runtime.

content.user_title: Manage creator records with traceable updates
content.value_statement: Creator details can become inconsistent across rates, rights, and campaign records. This skill queries and updates a single append-only registry with evidence and authorization checks.
actual_capabilities: Queries current creator facts by aggregate ID or verified handle context.
Prepares pending proposals for rates, rights, exclusivity, and performance facts.
Guides authorized acceptance or rejection through the registry runtime.
Tracks evidence dates, sources, revisions, and event identifiers.
Helps deduplicate creator handles using verified links or user confirmation.
Reports conflicts and expiring rights or exclusivity after verification.
limitations: It does not score creator fit or select campaign partners.
It does not review creator content or make compliance judgments.
Standalone installs can prepare proposals but cannot establish canonical registry state.
It requires a verified registry runtime and explicit authorization for persistent writes.

use_cases.title: Check prior commercial terms
use_cases.description: Find the current rate, usage rights, and exclusivity facts before reopening a creator discussion.

use_cases.title: Review incoming creator updates
use_cases.description: Review pending proposals in order and preserve the evidence and decision history.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign records
use_cases.description: Record approved campaign rates and performance baselines with dates and source references.

prompt_templates.title: Find a creator record
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current rate, rights, and exclusivity facts for creator-7f42.

prompt_templates.title: Review pending changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pending creator proposals for creator-7f42. List the evidence, revision, and recommended decision. Do not write changes yet.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an authorized update
prompt_templates.prompt: I authorize recording this closed campaign rate for creator-7f42. Validate the required source and date, then prepare the event request for my confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a record conflict
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the conflicting usage-rights evidence for creator-7f42. Preserve both sources and explain which fact should be current under the registry rules.

output_examples.input: Show the current commercial facts for creator-7f42.
output: Current rate: USD 1,900 for the defined bundle
Usage rights: organic use for six months
Source revision and evidence references included
Proposal A: rate update with dated signed-terms evidence
Proposal B: handle merge lacks verified cross-link evidence
Recommendation: accept A after authorization; keep B pending

best_practices: Use a pseudonymous aggregate ID and include dated evidence for every fact.
Ask for explicit authorization before creating the first persistent event.
Treat pending proposals as untrusted until an authorized decision accepts them.
anti_patterns: Do not manually edit the append-only event stream.
Do not merge similar creator names without verified links or user confirmation.
Do not store raw contact details or unnecessary personal history in registry records.

faq.question: Can this skill choose the best creator for a campaign?
faq.answer: No. It maintains registry facts. Use a fit-scoring skill for partner selection.

faq.question: Can it write a record without approval?
faq.answer: No. It asks for explicit authorization before the first persistent event.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide an aggregate ID or verified handle context, the fact, a source, and a date.

faq.question: Can it merge two creator records?
faq.answer: Only with verified cross-links, contact evidence, or direct user confirmation.

faq.question: What happens when evidence conflicts?
faq.answer: The skill preserves both sources and explains the adjudication using field, unit, and date rules.

faq.question: Does it work as a standalone folder?
faq.answer: It can prepare proposals, but canonical updates require the verified registry runtime.
